rca of the issue: Repro: login as driver (driver-001), app lands in no-order state, open browser console. Observed repeated DOM nesting/hydration errors around DriverSchedule table (`th/td/tr` under span wrappers). Likely root cause is invalid wrapper elements introduced around table row/cell structures during render path (or instrumentation wrapper interaction). Mitigation: ensure mapped table children inside `thead/tbody/tr` render only `tr/th/td` elements (or React fragments), no span/div wrappers around table structural tags; retest with driver no-order state.
